summary: One confirmed P1 prevents every authoritative successful archive-maintainer installation from resolving. Two passing negative tests are short-circuited by that same proof failure and do not yet exercise their intended fences.

findings.title: Approved installation resolver dereferences a nonexistent nested receipt and rejects every valid success
trigger: _loadReceipt validates record.receipt and returns the flat frozen receipt body.
getInstallation assigns that flat body directly to installation.receipt.
resolveApprovedArchiveInstallation checks installation.receipt.receipt?.state, which is undefined for every valid receipt.
The resolver throws PLATFORM_SKILL_INSTALL_CONFLICT; the runner converts it to ARCHIVE_RECOVERY_REQUIRED before source, draft, validation, publish, or terminal reconciliation.
findings.evidence: Exact-tree Linux candidate1 reports 10 introduced archive-runner failures; positive MANUAL/AUTO and all loss-recovery cases show ARCHIVE_RECOVERY_REQUIRED: PLATFORM_SKILL_INSTALL_CONFLICT.
findings.repair: Check the validated flat receipt state at installation.receipt.state. Preserve all existing result, command/package identity, current runtime scope, activation marker, exact 19-entry proof, inode/path identity, and reverify checks; do not accept an unvalidated raw receipt or result alone.

findings.title: Unknown-result and human-edit negative tests pass before reaching the behavior they claim to cover
trigger: Both tests install a valid package but execution stops at resolveApprovedArchiveInstallation because of M6-RUNNER-01.
The asserted RECOVERY_REQUIRED and zero draft PUT therefore occur without proving the unknown-result reconciliation path or the non-empty human revision fence.
findings.repair: After fixing M6-RUNNER-01, assert phase reachability: human-edit must observe context, source, and draft GET while draft PUT remains zero; unknown-result must observe start and later authoritative result lookup/denial before remaining RECOVERY_REQUIRED. Re-run positive, loss-response, publish-denial, terminal-routing, human-edit, and rotation/generation cases on the exact fixed tree.

verified_nonfindings: No Codex, shell, arbitrary-URL, or secret-prompt fallback was found in the reviewed runner path.
Runner terminal cache is checked only after the live registration fence; disconnect/rotation clears the runtime objects and aborts the session.
Draft producer write is limited to exact revision 0 plus exact empty content, and uncertain write recovery rereads authoritative state instead of issuing a second producer write.
Only server-authoritative COMPLETED or FAILED results are converted to terminal outcomes; other states remain recovery_required.
Default-off and Linux atomic-runtime advertisement behavior remains fail closed in the reviewed delta.
limitations: This is a local review of the frozen 12-file Client runner delta only.
No reviewer-run tests, WSL, Gradle, database, or source edits were performed.
No real API HTTP/runtime end-to-end execution was verified.
AUTO/resume API internals, M7, Web, scheduler, and unrelated accepted lifecycle slices were not re-audited.
The current mutable worktree was not used as the review identity; source conclusions are bound to Git tree 432ddf9658fb8bcc2cdbafdf01b15e18a7607543 and the recorded source-proof blobs.
